commentary.text: 90+7' Alejandro Quintero is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Leo Roman (Mallorca) has tested the patience of referee Alejandro Quintero and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90+5' Alejandro Quintero shows the yellow card to Mikel Jauregizar (Ath Bilbao) for a heavy challenge.
90+3' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.

90+2' Yet another yellow card and Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) is sent off for talking out of turn to the referee. Definitely a harebrained moment from the player. Alejandro Quintero doesn't allow any discussions.
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Alejandro Quintero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Alejandro Quintero shows a yellow card to Jesus Areso (Ath Bilbao), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90' Ath Bilbao quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
89' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) attempts to discuss the decision with Alejandro Quintero, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
88' Substitution. Johan Mojica will be replaced by Toni Lato (Mallorca).
88' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) is replaced by Mateu Morey Bauza.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) is coming onto the pitch as Manu Morlanes cannot continue after picking up an injury.
82' 2 - 1 Goal! Jesus Areso manages to prod the ball to Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
82' Substitution. Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta walks off the pitch and Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) comes on as a substitute.
82' Ernesto Valverde has decided to make a change. Izeta (Ath Bilbao) replaces Robert Navarro.
81' It will be a corner kick for Ath Bilbao.
81' Ath Bilbao are seeing far more of the ball now.

77' 1 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Samu Costa (Mallorca) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the top right corner. Unai Simon just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:1.
75' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) kept talking out of turn to the referee until Alejandro Quintero lost patience and pulled out a yellow card.
72' The attendance is 47098.

72' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.
71' Unai Simon displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
69' A quickly taken corner by Ath Bilbao.
68' Referee Alejandro Quintero has finally had enough of Jagoba Arrasate and brandishes a yellow card at him!
66' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Marc Domenech will be replaced by Javier Llabres (Mallorca).
66' The referee signals a substitution. Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) is brought on as a substitute for Pablo Torre.
65' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) and Mikel Jauregizar combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
65' The shots on goal statistics – 3:0.
63' Dangerous play by Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca). Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Ath Bilbao take a short corner kick.
62' Here is a change. Gorka Guruzeta is going off and Ernesto Valverde gives the last tactical orders to Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao).
62' The referee allows time for a substitution. Nico Serrano will be replaced by Alejandro Rego (Ath Bilbao).
58' One of the players from Mallorca times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
57' A pass by Marc Domenech (Mallorca) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
53' Ernesto Valverde is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Inaki Williams suffers an injury and Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
50' Mallorca are ruled offside.
48' Aymeric Laporte (Ath Bilbao) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Alejandro Quintero didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
46' A player from Ath Bilbao commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
46' Referee Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Alejandro Quintero had an easy-decision to make.
45+1' Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
41' Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
38' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.
38' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Johan Mojica (Mallorca), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
36' Alejandro Quintero shows a yellow card to Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) for his blatant foul.
35' The current number of shots on goal is 3:0.
34' The Mallorca players are exchanging some short passes.
33' Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
31' The Ath Bilbao players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Ath Bilbao are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
25' Mallorca seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
22' The ball is out of play and Ath Bilbao manage to earn a corner.
21' Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) misses a sitter from inside the six-yard box after striking the ball narrowly wide of the goal.
19' What a wasted opportunity by Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao)! He unleashed a powerful low shot from the centre of the box, but Leo Roman makes a decent save to thwart him.
17' Nico Serrano (Ath Bilbao) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
16' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) finds Gorka Guruzeta with a nice pass so he can go on towards the goal.
15' Mallorca are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
14' Nice passing game by Ath Bilbao. They are increasing their possession with a series of long passes and waiting for the right moment to create an attacking opportunity.
11' Ath Bilbao have been awarded a free kick.
9' 1 - 0 Goal! Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) calmly steps up and places the ball into the bottom left corner.
9' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
8' Referee Alejandro Quintero awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

8' There's a break in play and referee Alejandro Quintero must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Ath Bilbao using VAR. This could be interesting!
7' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
6' Ath Bilbao have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Corner kick. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity.

5' Robert Navarro (Ath Bilbao) lacks options so goes solo. It's a fine run and good shot from inside the box, but it's a whisker past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.

4' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is in acres of space inside the box and lets fly with a shot which goes well wide of the right post. What a poor effort. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca will have a goal kick.
4' Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
2' Dani Vivian (Ath Bilbao) fires the ball to the top left corner, but Leo Roman saves it.
2' Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) makes a slide tackle, but referee Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul. Ath Bilbao get a free kick.
1' Great teamplay by Ath Bilbao as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
